status_semantics.rule: Design mapping does not imply implementation. A feature may be marked implemented/built/tested only with linked repository evidence and test evidence.

ownership_and_mapping_rules: Every stable feature ID is preserved from the source catalog.
Each feature has exactly one proposed primary logical owner; secondary contributors belong in dependency edges.
Every feature must link to one or more manifest requirement/component records before approval.
Acceptance criteria and test cases must be feature-specific; generic engine tests are insufficient.
A feature is not complete merely because its parent engine specification exists.
Applicability is decided per project and target, not globally by deleting catalog entries.
No feature status is advanced automatically by documentation creation.

first_playable_scope.rule: Every feature requires independent Java and Bedrock applicability, implementation mapping and acceptance evidence. Do not infer cross-platform parity.

dependency_edges.rationale: Edition determines the version domains to resolve.
Edition determines the valid loader and pack platform.
Dependencies must be scoped to the selected edition.
The game version constrains compatible loaders and pack formats.
Version constraints are inputs to dependency resolution.
Environment preflight must verify the selected game version.
Runtime role determines component execution and distribution roles.
Preflight requirements depend on the selected runtime.
Loader and platform determine valid dependency families.
Dependency resolution must enforce loader and platform compatibility.
Loader/platform affects component packaging and runtime roles.
Declared dependencies must be resolved and conflict-checked.
Dependency roles affect distribution and runtime placement.
Third-party dependencies require provenance and license records.
Persistent configuration changes require versioned migration rules.

traceability_update_notes: BASE-001..BASE-012 are mapped to feature-specific requirements, acceptance criteria and test cases in the foundation compatibility specification.
The 15 feature-to-feature dependency edges are proposed and require review; they do not constitute implementation dependencies verified in code.
Java Edition, Bedrock Edition and parity remain not_assessed until target-specific builds, runtime tests and evidence exist.
All 232 implementation statuses remain not_implemented_verified; no evidence records were created by this documentation update.
